stem: During the time between the passage of the Gulf of Tonkin Resolution and the start of the Tet offensive, what happened in the Vietnam War?

options.label: F
options.text: All U.S. civilians were evacuated from Vietnam.

options.label: G
options.text: Peace talks between South Vietnam and North Vietnam were conducted in Paris.

options.label: H
options.text: The U.S. government deployed more troops to Vietnam.

options.label: J
options.text: South Vietnam surrendered to North Vietnam.

visual_elements: passage of the Gulf of Tonkin Resolution
